primary_evidence_source: Zhang et al. 2022, Nature Communications (41467_2022_33365_MOESM6_ESM.xlsx) + NanoString PanCancer IO 360 annotation (a2f1293b8766f86ca8c59ad3babc3261.xlsx)
superseded_assumptions_quarantined: Single-lock unmasked Angiopep-2 (LRP1) delivery — QUARANTINED because LRP1 is enriched 3.50x (+1.8066 log2FC, p=9.92e-9, q=1.48e-6) in peritumoral brain myeloid/microglial stroma (TIME-B) vs lung brain metastasis core (LB), creating a severe off-tumor myeloid sink.

MMP9 brain-stroma protease gate — QUARANTINED because MMP9 is absent from brain TIME-B vs LB significant DEGs and is only significantly enriched in primary lung stroma TIME-L vs L (+1.8776 log2FC, 3.68x, p=1.19e-8, q=5.29e-7).

zhang2022_competing_ligand_constraint.engineering_rule: Calibrate Angiopep-2 surface density to complete luminal-to-abluminal endothelial LRP1 transcytosis while avoiding high-avidity lysosomal sorting and accounting for 10.20x endogenous APOE competition in the abluminal TIME-B peritumoral cuff.

stage_2_peritumoral_deshielding.name: Peritumoral Protease-Triggered Stealth De-Shielding
stage_2_peritumoral_deshielding.stealth_mechanism: MMP2-cleavable PEG2000 stealth corona (peptide substrate GPLGIAGQ / PLGLAG)
stage_2_peritumoral_deshielding.rejected_protease: MMP9 (absent in TIME-B vs LB; restricted to lung TIME-L vs L, +1.8776 log2FC, q=5.29e-7)

LRP1.role: Off-tumor peritumoral myeloid/microglial sink (3.50x higher in TIME-B than LB tumor core)

stage_2_peritumoral_deshielding.engineering_rule: Maintain PEG2000 steric shielding across the LRP1+ CD163+ MRC1+ peritumoral myeloid cuff to prevent premature phagocytosis/sequestration by the 3.50x LRP1+ myeloid sink; cleave the PEG corona via 3.66x enriched MMP2 at the TIME-B / LB invasive interface.

stage_3_malignant_core_endocytosis.name: Malignant Core Receptor-Locked Endocytosis & Endosomal Escape
secondary_tumor_cell_receptor_locks: EGFR (EGF/anti-EGFR scFv or GE11 peptide for EGFR-mutant/amplified LB tumor cells)
CEACAM5 (tusamitamab-derived scFv for CEACAM5+ NSCLC BrM)
stage_3_malignant_core_endocytosis.intracellular_release: PDPA protonation at endosomal pH 6.3 (6.8-6.0) -> endosomal membrane disruption -> cytosolic release of CRISPRi dCas9-KRAB / SpCas9 KO RNP or verubecestat payload.

CRISPRi_dCas9_KRAB_TSS.af3_validation: 5/5 models pass; true CIF R-loop conformation: sgRNA↔Template DNA_B ipTM = 0.418 mean / 0.43 m0, DNA_A↔DNA_B duplex ipTM = 0.230, spacer PAE = 16.87 A vs 23.04 A non-template (ΔPAE = 6.17 A), 0 clashes
CRISPRi_dCas9_KRAB_TSS.secondary_target: FAM72A (spacer GGAACAAGACAGGGAGCAGA, chr1:206204398 -, sgRNA↔Template DNA_A ipTM = 0.382 mean / 0.39 m0, ΔPAE = 5.75 A)

SpCas9_KO_coding_exon.status: 4-chain SpCas9 RNP specification in data/brm/af3_cas9_rnp_BACE1.json; requires 4-chain AF3 fold verification

small_molecule_synergy.dual_compartment_rationale: Targets both Compartment 1 malignant tumor_like BACE1 (LFC = +1.0688, p = 0.0158; EGFR ectodomain cleavage) and Compartment 2 brain-metastatic immune_aggregate BACE1 (LFC = +1.8268 [3.55x], p = 0.00224, padj = 0.0161; M2 myeloid cuff reprogramming).
